newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Blue chips lift Swedish shares slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips lift Swedish shares slightly higher.

text.p: 1105 GMT - Swedish shares were somewhat higher around midday on Friday with blue chips gaining.
* Stockholm general index 0.30 percent up to 2,809.65
* Telecoms group Ericsson jumps four crowns to 272
after a newspaper article said the company sees a total mobile phone market of up to 300 million crowns in 2000.

* Drugs major Astra and automotive group Volvo rise as options are expiring. Astra also benefited from saying it expected to get its asthma treatment the Pulmicort Turbuhaler approved in the United States
Astra rises 2.5 crowns to 326, while Volvo jumps three crowns to 210.5.
* Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz keeps advancing, up four to 278.
* Car safety equipment company Autoliv is seeing some profit taking, down 4.5 crowns to 300 after surging 10.5 crowns a day earlier.
* Steel group Avesta Sheffield drops two crowns to 82.5 after releasing releasing a lower than expected full year result a day earlier.
